name: Magus Rimtori
summary: In Azshara, Magus Rimtori leads a blood elf expedition among the ancient ruins. She won passage across Kalimdor by deceiving the Horde, then slaughtered her orcish escort.

sections.title: A Deadly Deception
sections.body:
Magus Rimtori brought high-borne blood elves across the sea to Azshara's ancient shores. To carry them safely through Kalimdor, she charmed and manipulated the orc Belgrom until he agreed to provide an armed escort. Once his soldiers brought her to Azshara, Rimtori turned on her protectors and slaughtered the entire garrison.

Her forces now hold the Thalassian Base Camp. Rimtori ventures into the coastal wilds with elite bodyguards, seeking forgotten magical artifacts.

sections.title: Secrets of the Ruins
sections.body:
Kim'jael, a goblin surveyor betrayed by Rimtori, says she was obsessed with finding an ancient rune. The true purpose of her expedition remains secret, and her ruthless methods have earned her many enemies.

Rimtori also betrayed local hirelings. Among the relics left in her camp lies a demonic summoning tome. The Horde she crossed now seeks vengeance for its fallen soldiers.

faq.q: Why does the Horde want Rimtori dead?
aliases: what did rimtori do to the horde
faq.answer: Rimtori deceived the orc Belgrom into providing an armed escort for her expedition across Kalimdor. After his soldiers brought her safely to Azshara, she betrayed them and slaughtered every orc under his command.

faq.q: Where can Magus Rimtori be found?
faq.answer: Rimtori's expedition holds the Thalassian Base Camp. She roams Azshara's wilderness with her personal blood elf bodyguards, searching for ancient relics.

faq.q: What was Rimtori searching for in Azshara?
faq.answer: Kim'jael, the goblin Rimtori hired and then betrayed, says she hunted for an ancient rune. She also sought potent relics, including a Kaldorei tome of summoning.
Magister Hawkhelm is the blood elf officer Rimtori entrusted with commanding and supervising the Thalassian Base Camp while she investigates the surrounding ruins.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you know Rimtori deceived Belgrom and slaughtered the orc guard sent to escort her. Horde warriors seek to avenge their fallen kin, and she is a priority target.
As a mage, you can see how far Thalassian magi will go in pursuit of arcane power. They search Kalimdor's ruins and demonic relics.
